summary: Coursera filed an 8-K covering its Q2 2026 results and a strategic minority investment. Coursera purchased Series A Preferred Stock of LearnVector Inc., an AI-learning company founded by Andrew Ng, for $100 million, representing 33.33% fully diluted ownership. The board formed a Special Committee of independent directors to approve the related-party transaction; closing occurred at signing. The filing provides no price per share or premium, and the investment is not a public-market tender, acquisition, or restructuring. No break fee or expected close is stated. Watch for commercial collaboration agreements and potential regulatory or related-party scrutiny.
